questions.question: Why is ordinal alone a fragile chunk identity?

The identity of whoever owns the source document

Renaming would mint a new logical identity for one document
A title is always treated as a secret by the source system
Document IDs are required to be random rather than derived values

questions.question: What does domain separation add to a derived hash ID?

questions.question: What happens to a deterministic embedding ID when the model version changes?

questions.question: Why must canonicalization be versioned?

questions.topic: Stable IDs and Content Addressing via Hashing
questions.question: Why should raw hashes of low-entropy secrets not be exposed?
